_about: INVENTED DATA for a book example. Immutable artifact: never edit a published version, write a new one.
name: get_hcp_profile
description: Look up one HCP's profile in the HCP 360 data product by NPI. Returns only the fields the caller's role is entitled to see.

npi.description: The HCP's 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI), as a string so leading digits are kept.

territory_id.description: The territory to search in, for example T-NE-101.

as_of_date.description: Optional. Snapshot date of the data product, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest.
